letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad whispers your name. Today, as the gentle breeze carries the scent of jasmine, I’m reminded how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with my favorite cutie. Your smile turns ordinary moments into endless adventures, and even the distance between our two homes feels like a sweet, shared heartbeat. I love you more with each passing day—thank you for being my forever love.
poem:
In sand and spice, our laughter roams,  
Two hearts entwined, our love finds homes.  
From sunrise dunes to monsoon rain,  
With you, my jaan, I’m whole again.
